whatChanged: NEW: Vår Energi (VAR.OL) agrees to buy ConocoPhillips' Norwegian upstream business, including Greater Ekofisk operatorship, for ~$4.4bn EV (confirmed)
NEW: GTCR lines up Blackstone, Warburg Pincus and Apollo to back a ~$50bn take-private of Global Payments (GPN), Reuters reports (rumored)
ADVANCED: Sanofi (SAN.PA) agrees to buy Insmed (INSM) for $175 a share in cash, ~$41bn (rumored → confirmed)
ADVANCED: Clariant confirms talks with CD&R to acquire Ashland (ASH) (rumored → confirmed)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsors, strategics and insiders keep trying to take listed businesses off public markets, and shareholders keep deciding the outcome. GTCR, Global Payments' largest holder, is lining up Blackstone, Warburg Pincus and Apollo to back a ~$50bn take-private (gpn-gtcr-take-private). TPG and Corpay agreed a $6bn cash take-private of BILL at $63.25 a share (bill-tpg-take-private). Challenger has rejected a second, revised bid from its ~20% holder Dai-ichi Life (cgf-daiichi-life-takeover-proposal). ICEYE has launched a €41-a-share cash tender to take Avio private (avio-iceye-takeover-offer). easyJet holders approved Apollo's £5.7bn take-private (ezj-apollo-take-private), and CVC and GBL have crossed 90% of Recordati, clearing the way to delisting (rec-cvc-gbl-take-private). H&R REIT unitholders voted down the C$6.7bn breakup led by GO Residential and Blackstone (hr-un-go-residential-breakup). HealthSpan raised its Surgery Partners price to $25 after a rival $28 approach (sgry-bon-secours-take-private). Silver Lake and PIF have held talks to take Unity private at about $25bn (u-silver-lake-pif-take-private). Wendy's rejected Trian's $7.35 bid and adopted a poison pill (wen-trian-take-private), and LCI holders sidelined Monomoy's $104.50 cash approach by approving the Patrick merger (lcii-monomoy-takeover-proposal, lcii-patrick-merger). AVID has matched Warburg Pincus at A$5.55 for Ingenia (ina-avid-takeover-proposal), and Viatris has completed its tender for Pacira, which leaves Nasdaq (pcrx-viatris-acquisition).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Regulators, courts, governments and supervisors, not the parties, keep setting deal timelines. Telus says the 'largest hurdle' to Quebecor's C$31bn proposal is regulatory, since it would cut Canada's national carriers from four to three (t-quebecor-takeover-proposal). UniCredit needed unconditional EU clearance and a settlement with Berlin before its Commerzbank takeover could proceed (cbk-unicredit-takeover). The US Justice Department will review DoorDash's $17bn Instacart deal, with closing not expected before late 2027 (cart-doordash-uber-acquisition). Intesa's Monte dei Paschi offer has Consob and ECB sign-off, leaving Italy's antitrust authority as the remaining gatekeeper (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Mitsui Chemicals' $11.6bn JSR purchase needs Japanese and foreign approvals (4183-jsr-acquisition), and ICEYE's Avio offer needs Italian, French and UK clearances amid political resistance in Rome (avio-iceye-takeover-offer). easyJet's Apollo take-private and the LCI–Patrick merger now wait only on regulators (ezj-apollo-take-private, lcii-patrick-merger). Western Union terminated its Intermex purchase after California's financial regulator imposed conditions it would not accept (wu-intermex-acquisition). The FTC and states have sued to block Cencora's $3.5bn sale of MWI Animal Health to Covetrus (cor-covetrus-mwi-divestiture), and GO Residential has taken H&R REIT to court over a termination fee (hr-un-go-residential-breakup).

themes.label: Large-caps scaling up buybacks and special payouts on surplus cash
themes.note: Companies with surplus capital keep expanding buybacks and payouts. Costco declared a $30-a-share (~$13.3bn) special dividend alongside a new $4bn repurchase programme (cost-special-dividend-2026), and Lam Research authorized a new open-ended $25bn programme, far above the ~$3.9bn it repurchased in fiscal 2026 (lrcx-buyback-2026).

themes.label: European incumbents consolidating domestic rivals for scale
themes.note: Europe's banks, chemicals groups and space companies are pursuing rivals for scale, while controlling shareholders, governments and supervisors decide the outcomes. UniCredit has reached broad agreement with Berlin on taking over Commerzbank (cbk-unicredit-takeover). Banco BPM's board has opened talks on Crédit Agricole's proposal to merge its Italian arm into the bank (bami-credit-agricole-merger), and Intesa Sanpaolo's Monte dei Paschi offer opens on 24 November (isp-bmps-takeover-offer). Finland's ICEYE is bidding for Italian launcher maker Avio to build a European space and defence group (avio-iceye-takeover-offer). Not every attempt lands: BASF walked away from Evonik after the board refused to engage and North Rhine-Westphalia opposed the deal (evk-basf-acquisition).

themes.label: North American energy companies buying scale in core assets
themes.note: Oil, gas and Permian land companies are paying up to deepen positions in assets they already know. Texas Pacific Land agreed a ~$3.0bn all-stock purchase of Permian surface-acreage owner EagleRock, taking it to ~1.0m fee surface acres (tpl-eaglerock-acquisition). Canadian Natural is paying ~C$2.53bn including debt for Montney producer Advantage Energy (cnq-advantage-energy-acquisition). Chevron is reported by the FT to be closing in on a majority stake in Blackstone-backed Gulf producer Beacon Offshore, valued near $5bn (cvx-beacon-offshore-acquisition). Diamondback has signed to buy out the rest of its Double Eagle partnership (fang-double-eagle-acquisition) and Strathcona is folding in fellow Waterous-controlled oil sands producer Greenfire (scr-greenfire-acquisition).
